Inspired by the life of pro football player Spencer Paysinger.
director: Berlanti Productions, Warner Bros. Television, CBS Television Studios

name: SC - Amazing Stories
plot: Each episode transports the audience to worlds of wonder through the lens of today’s most imaginative filmmakers, directors and writers. A reimagining of the original anthology series by Steven Spielberg.

name: SC - Arrow
plot: Spoiled billionaire playboy Oliver Queen is missing and presumed dead when his yacht is lost at sea. He returns five years later a changed man, determined to clean up the city as a hooded vigilante armed with a bow.
director: Berlanti Productions, DC Entertainment, Warner Bros. Television

name: SC - Angel
plot: The vampire Angel, cursed with a soul, moves to Los Angeles and aids people with supernatural-related problems while questing for his own redemption. A spin-off from Buffy the Vampire Slayer.
director: Mutant Enemy Productions, Kuzui Enterprises, Sandollar Productions, 20th Century Fox Television

name: SC - Avenue 5
plot: 40 years in the future, space captain Ryan Clark and the crew of the luxury space cruise ship Avenue 5 navigate disgruntled passengers and unexpected events after experiencing technical difficulties onboard.

name: SC - Baron Noir
plot: In a tale of epic scale, French politician Philippe Rickwaert thirsts for revenge against his political enemies. Philippe’s political career is in shambles after he is sacrificed by the presidential candidate from the Left, Francis Laugier, in order to save his election. Step by step, Philippe plots against him and forges an alliance with his closest advisor, Amélie Dorendeu.

name: SC - Better Call Saul
plot: Six years before Saul Goodman meets Walter White. Working alongside, and, often, against Jimmy, is “fixer” Mike Ehrmantraut. The series tracks Jimmy’s transformation into Saul Goodman, the man who puts “criminal” in “criminal lawyer".

name: SC - Black Lightning
plot: Jefferson Pierce is a man wrestling with a secret. As the father of two daughters and principal of a charter high school that also serves as a safe haven for young people in a New Orleans neighborhood overrun by gang violence, he is a hero to his community.
director: Warner Bros. Television, Akil Production Company, Berlanti Productions

name: SC - Blindspot
plot: A vast international plot explodes when a beautiful Jane Doe is discovered naked in Times Square, completely covered in mysterious, intricate tattoos with no memory of who she is or how she got there. But there's one tattoo that is impossible to miss: the name of FBI agent Kurt Weller, emblazoned across her back. "Jane," Agent Weller and the rest of the FBI quickly realize that each mark on her body is a crime to solve, leading them closer to the truth about her identity and the mysteries to be revealed.
director: Quinn's House, Warner Bros. Television, Berlanti Productions

name: SC - Bloodride
plot: The doomed passengers aboard a spectral bus head toward a gruesome, unknown destination in this deliciously macabre horror anthology series.

name: SC - Castle
plot: After a serial killer imitates the plots of his novels, successful mystery novelist Richard "Rick" Castle receives permission from the Mayor of New York City to tag along with an NYPD homicide investigation team for research purposes.
director: Beacon Pictures, Experimental Pictures, ABC Studios

name: SC - Chance
plot: San Francisco-based forensic neuropsychiatrist Eldon Chance reluctantly gets sucked into a violent and dangerous world of mistaken identity, police corruption and mental illness.

name: SC - Dare Me
plot: Dive into the cutthroat world of competitive high school cheerleading, following the fraught relationship between two best friends after a new coach arrives to bring their team to prominence.

name: SC - Deadwater Fell
plot: When a seemingly perfect and happy family is murdered by someone they knew and trusted, cracks appear on the surface of a supposedly idyllic community.

name: SC - Designated Survivor
plot: Tom Kirkman, a low-level cabinet member is suddenly appointed President of the United States after a catastrophic attack during the State of the Union kills everyone above him in the Presidential line of succession.

name: SC - Emergence
plot: A police chief takes in a young child she finds near the site of a mysterious accident who has no memory of what has happened. The investigation draws her into a conspiracy larger than she ever imagined, and the child’s identity is at the center of it all.

name: SC - Feel Good
plot: Recovering addict and comedian Mae tries to control the addictive behaviors and intense romanticism that permeate every facet of her life. Life is further complicated by a new and all-consuming relationship with her new girlfriend George.

name: SC - Frasier
plot: After many years spent at the “Cheers” bar, Frasier moves back home to Seattle to work as a radio psychiatrist after his policeman father gets shot in the hip on duty.
director: Grammnet Productions, Grub Street Productions, Paramount Television

name: SC - Freakish
plot: A group of students trapped in a high school must fight for survival when predatory mutant freaks take over after a meltdown at the local chemical plant.

name: SC - Gotham

What did it take to navigate the multiple layers of corruption that secretly ruled Gotham City, the spawning ground of the world's most iconic villains? director: DC Entertainment, Primrose Hill Productions, Warner Bros. Television

name: SC - Grace and Frankie
plot: Elegant, proper Grace and freewheeling, eccentric Frankie are a pair of frenemies whose lives are turned upside down - and permanently intertwined - when their husbands leave them for each other. Together, they must face starting over in their 70s in a 21st century world.

name: SC - Hawaii Five-0
plot: Steve McGarrett returns home to Oahu, in order to find his father's killer. The governor offers him the chance to run his own task force (Five-0). Steve's team is joined by Chin Ho Kelly, Danny "Danno" Williams, and Kono Kalakaua.
director: K/O Paper Products, 101st Street Entertainment, CBS Television Studios

name: SC - High Maintenance
plot: Jump into the daily routines of a diverse group of New Yorkers and how they light things up. “The Guy” is a nameless pot deliveryman whose client base includes an eccentric group of characters with neuroses as diverse as the city.

name: SC - Caliphate
plot: National Security agent Fatima receives a tip that a terrorist attack against Sweden is in the planning stage. Meanwhile Sulle, a teenage girl in Stockholm, gets interested in her student assistent who opens doors to a new and fascinating world - the true path.  Kalifat is a thriller about the intermingled fates of five young women who get caught up in the seducing and destroying force of religious fundamentalism.
director: SVT, Filmlance International, Film Capital Stockholm

name: SC - The Returned
plot: A small town that is turned upside down when several local people, who have long been presumed dead, suddenly reappear; their presence creates both positive and negative consequences. As families are reunited, the lives of those who were left behind are challenged both physically and emotionally.
director: Haut et Court, A+E Studios, FremantleMedia North America

name: SC - McMillion$
plot: A detailed account of the McDonald's Monopoly game scam during the 1990s as told by the participants in the case, including the prizewinners and the FBI agents who caught the security officer who orchestrated the entire scheme.

name: SC - Monk
plot: Adrian Monk was once a rising star with the San Francisco Police Department, legendary for using unconventional means to solve the department's most baffling cases. Now working as a private consultant, Monk continues to investigate cases in the most unconventional ways.
director: Mandeville Films, ABC Studios, Moratim Produktions, Universal Television, Touchstone Television, USA Cable Entertainment, Universal Media Studios (UMS)

name: SC - Outlander
plot: The story of Claire Randall, a married combat nurse from 1945 who is mysteriously swept back in time to 1743, where she is immediately thrown into an unknown world where her life is threatened. When she is forced to marry Jamie, a chivalrous and romantic young Scottish warrior, a passionate affair is ignited that tears Claire's heart between two vastly different men in two irreconcilable lives.
director: Tall Ships Productions, Left Bank Pictures, Sony Pictures Television, Story Mining and Supply Company

name: SC - Ozark
plot: A financial adviser drags his family from Chicago to the Missouri Ozarks, where he must launder $500 million in five years to appease a drug boss.
director: Media Rights Capital, Zero Gravity Management

name: SC - Prison Break
plot: Due to a political conspiracy, an innocent man is sent to death row and his only hope is his brother, who makes it his mission to deliberately get himself sent to the same prison in order to break the both of them out, from the inside out.
director: Prison Break Productions, Adelstein-Parouse Productions, Original Television, 20th Century Fox Television

director: 20th Century Fox Television, Danny Strong Productions

name: SC - Rig 45
plot: When Andrea, a damage regulator from Benthos Oil, is sent out to Rig 45 two days before Christmas to investigate a fatal accident, the rig is hit by a hurricane and all communications lost. name: SC - Riverdale
plot: Set in the present, the series offers a bold, subversive take on Archie, Betty, Veronica and their friends, exploring the surreality of small-town life, the darkness and weirdness bubbling beneath Riverdale’s wholesome facade.

name: SC - Seinfeld
plot: A stand-up comedian and his three offbeat friends weather the pitfalls and payoffs of life in New York City in the '90s. It's a show about nothing.
director: Columbia TriStar Television, West-Shapiro, Castle Rock Entertainment

name: SC - Shop Class
plot: Youthful ingenuity is on display in this new competition series that features teams of inventive students tasked with designing, building, and testing new contraptions to vie for the title of Shop Class Champs. In each episode, they’ll present their work to a panel of experts who will rate their projects based on engineering, design, and the final test of the build.

name: SC - Star Trek: Picard
plot: Set twenty years after the events of Star Trek Nemesis, we follow the now-retired Admiral Picard into the next chapter of his life.

name: SC - Tales from the Loop
plot: The story of the town and people who live above “The Loop,” a machine built to unlock and explore the mysteries of the universe – making things possible that were previously relegated only to science fiction.
director: 6th & Idaho, Amazon Studios, Fox 21 Television Studios, Indio

name: SC - Teen Wolf

Throughout the series, he strives to keep his loved ones safe while maintaining normal relationships with them.

name: SC - The Big Bang Theory

director: Chuck Lorre Productions, Warner Bros. Television

Their lives are disrupted in unexpected ways when Lena meets Callie, a hardened teen with an abusive past who has spent her life in and out of foster homes. Lena and Stef welcome Callie and her brother, Jude, into their home thinking it's just for a few weeks, until a more permanent placement can be found. But life has something else in store for the Fosters.

name: SC - The Hockey Girls
plot: The passionate members of a girls' roller hockey team chase down victories in the rink while striving to make time for school, family and romance.

name: SC - The Inbetweeners
plot: Welcome to a world of futile crushes, sibling brawls, getting drunk too quickly and casting constant aspersions about your friends' sexuality.

name: SC - The Letter for the King
plot: A young boy holds the fate of the kingdom in his hands when he embarks on a quest to deliver a secret message in this sweeping fantasy series.

name: SC - The Magicians
plot: Brakebills University is a secret institution specializing in magic. There, amidst an unorthodox education of spellcasting, a group of twenty-something friends soon discover that a magical fantasy world they read about as children is all too real— and poses grave danger to humanity.

name: SC - The Mentalist
plot: Patrick Jane, a former celebrity psychic medium, uses his razor sharp skills of observation and expertise at "reading" people to solve serious crimes with the California Bureau of Investigation.
director: Warner Bros. Television, Primrose Hill Productions

name: SC - The Widow
plot: A woman's search to uncover the mystery of the disappearance of her husband leads her to the Congo, where she's forced to seek the truth about what happened to the man she loved.

name: SC - Thicker Than Water

Anna-Lisa has summoned her daughter Jonna, an actress, and son Lasse, an opportunist, to the island. It is the first time in years that they are together again. When Anna-Lisa is found dead one morning, the siblings learn that she had terminal cancer: Her will stipulates that all three siblings must run the family B&B together for a year, or they won't inherit it at all. It is a mother’s last effort to reunite her children. But it will also confront them with the family’s unsolved past, present forces of attraction, and a very dark secret buried in a most unfortunate place...

name: SC - Treadstone
plot: The Treadstone project, having created super spy Jason Bourne, turns its attention on a new protocol to develop unstoppable superhuman assassins.

name: SC - Trust Me
plot: A series of gripping thrillers that expose the dark side of the people we trust to care for us - doctors.

name: SC - Unbreakable Kimmy Schmidt
plot: When a woman is rescued from a doomsday cult and lands in New York City, she must navigate a world she didn’t think even existed anymore.

name: SC - Unforgettable

The move allows her to try to find out the one thing she has been unable to remember, which is what happened the day her sister was murdered.
director: Sony Pictures Television, Timberman/Beverly Productions, CBS Television Studios

name: SC - Unsolved

name: SC - Reply 1994

Sometimes you’ve just got to look to your past in order to appreciate the present. Every generation is sure to find something to love in this field trip back into time!

name: SC - 2 Dope Queens

name: SC - Rich and Acquitted
plot: Some defendants can afford the best defense attorneys in the country. Evidence is twisted to create gaps of doubt. And in the end the defendants are acquitted even when they may appear guilty. Each hour-long episode of the documentary series Rich and Acquitted tells the story of celebrities who use their money in order to escape tricky legal situations.

name: SC - All Def Comedy
plot: All Def Comedy continues the HBO's legacy of promoting urban comedy. The original Def Comedy Jam helped launch the careers of a host of today’s comedy superstars, Dave Chappelle, Chris Tucker, Martin Lawrence, Steve Harvey, Kevin Hart, Cedric the Entertainer, Katt Williams, J.B. Smoove, Bill Bellamy, the late Bernie Mac and many more.

name: SC - American Crime Story
plot: An anthology series centered around some of history's most famous criminals.
director: Ryan Murphy Productions, Color Force, Brad Falchuk Teley-vision, FX Productions, Fox 21 Television Studios, Cinema Vehicle Services

name: SC - American Housewife
plot: A family comedy narrated by Katie, a strong-willed mother, raising her flawed family in a wealthy town filled with perfect wives and their perfect offspring.
director: Kapital Entertainment, ABC Studios, 3 Hounds Productions, Daddy's Girl Productions

After much deliberation, Ben decides to raise the baby with the help of his friends and his protective and sometimes over-bearing mother, Bonnie, and his close female friend, Riley.

name: SC - Banshee

name: SC - Barry
plot: A hit man from the Midwest moves to Los Angeles and gets caught up in the city's theatre arts scene.

name: SC - 100 Ting At Naa Inden High School
SC - Bella and the Bulldogs
plot: A head cheerleader's life takes an unexpected twist when her rifle-like throwing arm takes her from the sidelines to becoming her middle school’s starting quarterback. Bella Dawson is a confident, caring and talented teenager, who suddenly finds herself fulfilling a lifelong dream but also having to navigate the world of her teammates Troy, Sawyer and Newt, without losing her two best friends, Pepper and Sophie from the cheer squad.

name: SC - Berlin Station
plot: A contemporary spy series that follows Daniel Miller, an undercover agent at the CIA station in Berlin, Germany.
director: Studio Babelsberg, Paramount Television, Anonymous Content

name: SC - Big Time Rush
plot: Four teenage friends move from Minneapolis to Los Angeles to form a potential chart-topping boy band after Kendall is inadvertently discovered by an eccentric record executive, Gustavo Rocque. As they seize this opportunity of a lifetime, these friends embark on an exciting comedy and music-filled journey to prove to themselves and their record label that they are serious about their new career choice.

name: SC - Bones
plot: Dr. Temperance Brennan and her colleagues at the Jeffersonian's Medico-Legal Lab assist Special Agent Seeley Booth with murder investigations when the remains are so badly decomposed, burned or destroyed that the standard identification methods are useless.
director: 20th Century Fox Television, Far Field Productions, Josephson Entertainment

name: SC - Enlightened
plot: Enlightened follows the story of Amy, a self-destructive executive, who, after a very public breakdown and a subsequent philosophical awakening in rehabilitation, tries to get her life back together.

name: SC - Graves

His enlightenment takes place just as his wife Margaret Graves decides it’s finally time for her to pursue her own political ambitions.

name: SC - Hunters Hemmelighed
plot: A diverse band of Nazi Hunters living in 1977 New York City discover that hundreds of high ranking Nazi officials are living among us and conspiring to create a Fourth Reich in the U.S. The eclectic team of Hunters set out on a bloody quest to bring the Nazis to justice and thwart their new genocidal plans.

name: SC - Brews Brothers
plot: Two rival brothers must work together to keep their brewery in business, but shenanigans keep foaming up their company with chaos.

name: SC - Mr. Robot
plot: A contemporary and culturally resonant drama about a young programmer, Elliot, who suffers from a debilitating anti-social disorder and decides that he can only connect to people by hacking them. He wields his skills as a weapon to protect the people that he cares about. Elliot will find himself in the intersection between a cybersecurity firm he works for and the underworld organizations that are recruiting him to bring down corporate America.

name: SC - Ray Donovan
plot: Set in the sprawling mecca of the rich and famous, Ray Donovan does the dirty work for LA's top power players, and makes their problems disappear. His father's unexpected release from prison sets off a chain of events that shakes the Donovan family to its core.
director: The Mark Gordon Company, Bider Sweet

name: SC - Revenge
plot: When Emily Thorne moves to the Hamptons, everyone wonders about the new girl, but she knows everything about them, including what they did to her family. Years ago, they took everything from her. Now, one by one, she's going to make them pay.

name: SC - Sam & Cat
plot: Sam & Cat is an American teen sitcom that premiered June 8, 2013, on Nickelodeon. It is a crossover spin-off/sequel of both iCarly and Victorious. It stars Jennette McCurdy as Sam Puckett and Ariana Grande as Cat Valentine. The girls meet by chance during a bizarre adventure and become roommates, then start a babysitting business to earn extra money.

name: SC - Silicon Valley
plot: In the high-tech gold rush of modern Silicon Valley, the people most qualified to succeed are the least capable of handling success. Partially inspired by Mike Judge’s own experiences as a Silicon Valley engineer in the late ‘80s, Silicon Valley is an American sitcom that centers around six programmers who are living together and trying to make it big in the Silicon Valley.

name: SC - Strike Back
plot: The series follows John Porter, a former British Special Forces soldier, who is drafted back into service by Section 20, a fictional branch of the Secret Intelligence Service.
director: Double D Productions, Left Bank Pictures, Cinemax, Ingenious Broadcasting, British Sky Broadcasting

name: SC - The Gifted
plot: A suburban couple's ordinary lives are rocked by the sudden discovery that their children possess mutant powers. Forced to go on the run from a hostile government, the family joins up with an underground network of mutants and must fight to survive.
director: Walt Disney Television, 20th Century Fox Television, Marvel Television

name: SC - The Good Doctor
plot: A young surgeon with Savant syndrome is recruited into the surgical unit of a prestigious hospital. The question will arise: can a person who doesn't have the ability to relate to people actually save their lives?

name: SC - The X-Files
plot: The exploits of FBI Special Agents Fox Mulder and Dana Scully who investigate X-Files: marginalized, unsolved cases involving paranormal phenomena. Mulder believes in the existence of aliens and the paranormal while Scully, a skeptic, is assigned to make scientific analyses of Mulder's discoveries that debunk Mulder's work and thus return him to mainstream cases.

name: SC - Top of the Lake
plot: A woman haunted by her past, Detective Robin Griffin, investigates complex and unsettling cases.
director: Screen Australia, See-Saw Films, Escapade Pictures

name: SC - Unfabulous
plot:
Unfabulous is an American children's television series that aired on Nickelodeon. The series is about an "unfabulous" 7th Grade middle school student named Addie Singer, played by Emma Roberts. The show, which debuted in late summer 2004, was one of the most-watched programs in the United States among children between the age of 10 and 16 and was created by Sue Rose, who previously created the animated series Pepper Ann and Angela Anaconda.

The series ended on December 16, 2007, with the third season being the last.

Reruns of the show ended on Nickelodeon on June 2008. The show aired reruns on The N but ended in late 2009. The show then returned to TeenNick on October 11, 2011, and lasted until April 2, 2012. The show returned to the channel again on December 3, 2012.

All the episodes are narrated by Addie, and are told in flashbacks. The episode titles all start with the article "The".

The show's theme song is performed by Jill Sobule, who also writes the songs for the series.

name: SC - Victorious
plot: Aspiring singer Tori Vega navigates life while attending a performing arts high school called Hollywood Arts.

name: SC - Wolfblood
plot: Being a teenager is hard enough. Being a Wolfblood teenager is ten times more complicated. 14 year old Maddy loves her abilities - heightened senses, being faster, stronger and more graceful - but hates the secrets that come with them.

name: SC - After Life
plot: Tony had a perfect life. But after his wife Lisa suddenly dies, Tony changes. After contemplating taking his own life, he decides instead to live long enough to punish the world by saying and doing whatever he likes from now on.

name: SC - Breeders
plot: Breeders exposes the parental-paradox that it is possible, in the very same moment, to love your child to the horizon of the universe, while being apoplectically angry enough to want to send them there.
director: Avalon Television, BBC, British Sky Broadcasting, FX Productions

name: SC - Empire
plot: A powerful family drama about the head of a music empire whose three sons and ex-wife all battle for his throne.
director: 20th Century Fox Television, Imagine Television, Lee Daniels Entertainment, Little Chicken Productions

name: SC - Five Days
plot: Thriller series which tracks five 24-hour periods in a police investigation.

name: SC - How I Met Your Mother
plot: Ted Mosby recounts to his son and daughter the events that led to his meeting their mother.
director: Carter Bays, 20th Century Fox Television, 20th Television

name: SC - Human Target
plot: It takes a brave, selfless man to make himself a "human target" in order to save the lives of those in danger. Based on the popular DC Comics comic book and graphic novel, Human Target is a full-throttle action drama centered on Christopher Chance, a unique private contractor/security expert/bodyguard hired to protect.
director: Bonanza Productions, Wonderland Sound and Vision, DC Comics

name: SC - Kevin Can Wait
plot: A newly retired police officer looks forward to spending more quality time with his wife and three kids only to discover he faces much tougher challenges at home than he ever did on the streets.
director: Sony Pictures Television, Hey Eddie, CBS Television Studios

name: SC - The Last Man on Earth
plot: The year is 2022, and after an unlikely event, only one man is left on earth: Phil Miller, who used to be just an average guy who loved his family and hated his job at the bank. Now, in his RV, Phil searches the country for other survivors.

name: SC - Love Daily
plot: Romantic anthology web series revolving around 12 stories of 12 months of young people on their paths to love.

name: SC - Manhunt
plot: Inspired by actual events, this true crime anthology series takes a deep dive into the dark, twisted minds of terrorists and follows the brave souls who hunt them down.

name: SC - Marvel's Iron Fist
plot: Danny Rand resurfaces 15 years after being presumed dead. Now, with the power of the Iron Fist, he seeks to reclaim his past and fulfill his destiny.
director: Marvel Television, Devilina Productions, ABC Studios, Marvel Entertainment, Walt Disney Television

name: SC - Scream The TV Series
plot: What starts as a YouTube video going viral, soon leads to problems for the teenagers of Lakewood and serves as the catalyst for a murder that opens up a window to the town's troubled past. Everyone has secrets. Everyone tells lies. Everyone is fair game.
director: Dimension Television, DIGA Studios, Dimension Films

name: SC - Big Lars
plot: Get ready to get to know 'Big Lars' - because Lars Hjortshøj is tired of being 'Little Lars'. Tired of kind of silly roles with a stupid beard, tired of murky jobs, tired of being a man that has stalled in his midlife and never gotten the respect, he deserves. Because of that Lars ventures into a range of projects in his try to achieve real acknowledgement.

name: SC - The Last Kingdom
plot: A show of heroic deeds and epic battles with a thematic depth that embraces politics, religion, warfare, courage, love, loyalty and our universal search for identity. Combining real historical figures and events with fictional characters, it is the story of how a people combined their strength under one of the most iconic kings of history in order to reclaim their land for themselves and build a place they call home.

name: SC - The Plot Against America

plot:
The Scooby-Doo Show is the blanket name for the episodes from the third incarnation of the Hanna-Barbera Saturday morning cartoon Scooby-Doo. A total of 40 episodes ran for three seasons, from 1976 to 1978, on ABC, marking the first Scooby series to appear on the network. Sixteen episodes were produced as segments of The Scooby-Doo/Dynomutt Hour in 1976, eight episodes were produced as segments of Scooby's All-Star Laff-A-Lympics in 1977 and sixteen episodes were produced in 1978, with nine of them running by themselves under the Scooby-Doo, Where Are You! name and the final seven as segments of Scooby's All-Stars.

Despite the yearly changes in the way they were broadcast, the 1976–1978 stretch of Scooby episodes represents, at three seasons, the longest-running format of the original show before the addition of Scrappy-Doo. The episodes from all three seasons have been rerun under the title The Scooby-Doo Show since 1980; these Scooby episodes did not originally air under this title. The credits on these syndicated versions all feature a 1976 copyright date, even though some were originally produced in 1977 and 1978. Reruns are currently air on Boomerang.

Like many animated series created by Hanna-Barbera in the 1970s, the show contained a laugh track created by the studio.

name: SE - Svensson, Svensson
plot:
Svensson, Svensson is a Swedish sitcom. It has also been made into a feature film and a play.

Two seasons consisting of 12 episodes each were broadcast in the autumn of 1994 and the autumn of 1996. They have since been repeated numerous times. The series was revived for a third season in 2007.

Svensson, Svensson is one of the most successful sitcoms in Swedish television history. During the second season, each episode gathered more than 2.5 million viewers, in a country which at the time had a population of around 8.8 million people. The most watched episode was broadcast on 17 November 1996 and gathered 3,395,000 viewers.

The series centres around the Svensson family who lives in the Vivalla area of Örebro. The family consists of the father Gustav who works as mailman, the mother Lena who works at a bank, their teenage daughter Lina and their son Max.

For the revival, Gustav has had to retire from his work at the post office, while Lena works for the local government. Max now works at the bank and Lina has married the conductor John who brought his daughter Greta into the family.
cast: Allan Svensson, Suzanne Reuter, Gabriel Odenhammar, Claudia Galli Concha, Felix Engström, Embla Hjulström

Motvilligt tvingas Veronika acceptera att pojken kanske inte är en illusion.

Zig and Zag are alien twin teen brothers from the Planet Zog. One day they were out flying around in their spaceship when they get sucked into a random black hole (it happens!) and end up crash landing in the suburbs on a strange green and blue planet called Earth. With their craft beyond repair, the brothers decide the only thing to do is plant a porch on the front of their shiny metal spaceship and called it ‘home'.

Join our inseparable extra-terrestrial brothers on a series of fun adventures creating all manner of mayhem as they make the most of what this cool new planet has to offer. With death-defying stunts, crazy inventions and banana and mackerel smoothies!

Life in the suburbs will never be the same for friend Nellie from the corner shop and neighbours Mrs Eyebrows and her invisible cat Mr President, Mr and Mrs Jones and their creepy staring twins Brie and Stilton, the uber-competitive neighbours Abs and Pek Von Pumpiniron, and not forgetting the Secret Agents: Agent A Gent and Agent Honey, tasked with keeping an eye on the alien visitors.

name: SE - Tre kronor
plot:
Tre kronor was a Swedish soap opera that aired on TV4 during the period 1994-1999. The series took place in the fictive middle class suburb Mälarviken, located in the vicinity of Stockholm. The exteriors were filmed in Sätra, a suburb of Stockholm, and the interiors were filmed in a studio in Kvarnholmen as well as in Kungens Kurva. Tre kronor aired at the same time period as Rederiet was on SVT and the shows where rivals of the viewers and they both had around 1-2 million viewers. TV4 started Tre kronor in 1994 to compete for the viewers of Rederiet.

The signature tune was written by Lasse Holm.

The spin-off movie Reine och Mimmi i fjällen! was based on two of the characters; Reine and Mimmi.

The series had a dramatic ending where all the characters besides six were fatally wounded in a suicide bombing that took place at the local restaurant Tre Kronor. It was a priest himself who was the perpetrator. Two big cliffhangers in the series was when Hans Wästberg, played by Ulf Brunnberg, robbed the post office and shot his son Hans-Åke by mistake. Hans Wästberg was taken to prison and disappeared from the series after the second season. Season Three ended with Sirpa "Bimbo" Koskinen, the girlfriend of Hans-Åke Wästberg, died in a bus crash. Salongo played by Richard Sseruwagi was a refugee and a rich business man from Uganda who fell in love with a married police woman Lena Sjökvist played by Catharine Hansson and he later bought the restaurant Tre Kronor. Later in the series, Salongo buys another restaurant and he to disappeares from the series.
cast: Christina Schollin, Mona Andersson, Tomas Lehtinen, Matilda Lindell, Amelie Uggla, Sigrid Kernell, Olle Sundberg, Jonatan Rodriguez

plot: En ung gravid kvinna blir nergrävd i sanden, för att sakta bli dränkt av tidvattnet. 25 år senare är det sadistiska mordet fortfarande olöst. Olivia Rönning på Polishögskolan får i uppgift att studera fallet som en cold case-övning.
cast: Julia Ragnarsson, Kjell Bergqvist, Cecilia Nilsson, Dar Salim, Michaela Thorsén, Arvin Kananian, Michael Segerström, Kjell Wilhelmsen

name: SE - 112 Aina
plot: Älskade du Cops? Tänk dig att du tar realitykänslan från den succén och parar ihop den med det bästa ur långfilmer som Kopps eller Borat. 112 Aina är humorsatsningen som på ytan liknar en dokumentär, men som i själva verket är en hysterisk drift med den svenska polisen. Serien gästas av flera stora skådespelarnamn som Jakob Eklund, Andreas Wilson och Linus Wahlgren. I sin iver att visa upp polisens arbete från den allra bästa sidan klantar poliserna på Hjällby station ofta till det. Poliser som lånar ut vapen till allmänheten, inte upptäcker ett rån om det så sker på den pizzeria de sitter och äter på, eller en polis som hellre tar en joint än jagar buset. Nya humorserien 112 Aina blandar det bästa ur polisdokumentärer som Cops med succékomedier som Kopps i mockumentärstil. Serien gästas av flera av Sveriges största skådespelare som Jakob Eklund.
cast: Fredrik Hallgren, Annie Lundin, Isabel Munshi, Måns Nathanaelson, Niki Nordenskjöld, Annie Lundin, Evin Ahmad, Tapio Leopold

name: SE - Svartsjön
plot: Historien i Svartsjön tar sin början då den unga rikemanssonen Johan bestämmer sig för att öppna den tidigare nedlagda skidorten Svartsjön, som stängdes på grund av några mystiska dödsfall för 20 år sedan. Tillsammans med en grupp vänner och flickvännen Hanne tar Johan över stället, och gänget inleder en lustfylld vistelse med skidor, fest och flirtar. Men snart börjar mystiska händelser splittra gruppen, och när den extrema kylan gör livet svårt i Svartsjön börjar sprickorna i gänget bli allt tydligare.
director: Jonathan Sjöberg, Ulf Kvensler, David Berron

name: SE - Beck
plot: Martin Beck är en fiktiv polis som är huvudpersonen i Sjöwall/Wahlöös polisromaner. Beck är poliskommissarie och chef för riksmordkommissionen. Martin Beck är ofta trött och uppvisar en viss desillusion över sitt arbete. Följande filmer är inte baserade på någon av romanerna utan har bara delar av persongalleriet gemensamt med böckerna. Martin Beck spelas av Peter Haber och Gunvald Larsson av Mikael Persbrandt. Rollfiguren Kollberg är inte med i denna version, men omnämns av Beck och Gunvald som saknar honom i den första filmen. Således har han funnits med i spaningsgruppen, men slutat. En populär figur i den här serien är Ingvar Hirdwall som Becks rödhårige granne med stödkrage som alltid frågar: "Vill du ha en stänkare?"
cast: Peter Haber, Ingvar Hirdwall, Jennie Silfverhjelm, Måns Nathanaelson, Anna Asp, Martin Wallström, Elmira Arikan, Valter Skarsgård

name: SE - Sunes jul
plot: Sune, en 12 år gammal kamp med tjejproblem och skolan medan han och hans lustiga familj förbereder sig till jul med misslyckade försök av alla vanliga december traditioner
cast: Andreas Hoffer, Peter Haber, Carina Lidbom, Gabriel Odenhammar, Nina Almlöf, Rebecka Liljeberg

name: SE - Partisan
plot: En man får ett nytt jobb i de idylliska omgivningarna i Jordnära, ett inhägnat samhälle som driver en framgångsrik ekologisk gård. Men han inser snabbt att deras regler och rutiner är något oortodoxa.
cast: Anna Björk, Sofia Karemyr, Ylvali Rurling, Emelie Jonsson, Pelle Holmström, Nanna Blondell, Aaron Staton, Vala Norén

name: SE - Clark
plot: Det här är den otroliga berättelsen om Clark Olofsson, den kontroversielle brottslingen som inspirerade begreppet Stockholmssyndromet. Baserad på hans egna (o)sanningar.
cast: Bill Skarsgård, Kolbjörn Skarsgård, Lukas Wetterberg, Vilhelm Blomgren, Sandra Ilar, Peter Viitanen, Hanna Björn, Malin Levanon

name: SE - Huss
plot: När Katarina Huss börjar som polis måste hon lära sig att klara den hårda vardagen på Göteborgs gator. Samtidigt verkar hennes kollegor dölja något och snart dras hon in i en härva av korruption och svek.
cast: Karin Franz Körlof, Shirin Golchin, Filip Berg, Tove Wiréen, Nikolai Shervin, Kajsa Ernst, Victor Dohlsten, Robin Stegmar

name: SE - Sjölyckan
plot: I centrum står familjen Kling och deras paradis bland kobbar och skär i Stockholms skärgård, Sjölyckan. Den här sommaren skiljer sig från andra då det är den första sedan mamma Maud olyckligt dog och barnen har bestämt sig för att vara på Sjölyckan hela sommaren för att stötta sin far.
cast: Henrik Schyffert, Shima Niavarani, Gustaf Hammarsten, Malin Cederblad, Hans Mosesson, Marianne Mörck, Polly Albinsson, Frank Fogelström
director: Jacob Seth Fransson, Niclas Carlsson, Björn Öberg

name: SE - Sugarbabe
plot: Sole och Olivia är 15 år och har just startat ett konto på en sugardejtingsida med idén att blåsa killar på pengar. Pengarna behöver de för att kunna ta sig till USA och slå igenom som dansare. Deras största dröm i livet. Men de hamnar snabbt i problem när de via sidan träffar en man som börjar hota dem och kräva tillbaka sina pengar. Sugarbabe är en dramaserie i dansens värld om vänskap, utsatthet och att drömma stort.
cast: Julia Sjöberg, Estelle Löfgren Hadir, Vanessa Tsipogiannis, Adnan Sahuric, Julia Hansson

name: SE - Parterapi
plot: Christine Meltzer i tolv olika roller i en terapisoffa med igenkänning & humor där allt handlar om det viktigaste vi har - relationer. Baserad på den norska tv-succén med samma namn.
cast: Alexandra Alegren, Christine Meltzer, Jessica Forsberg, Maja Kin

name: SE - Trevligt folk deluxe
plot: Filip Hammar och Fredrik Wikingsson följde bildandet av Somalia bandy i Borlänge. 17 somaliska män skulle lära sig spela bandy på VM-nivå. Filip och Fredrik gör djupdykningar i de oväntade händelser som inträffade under den intensiva VM-uppladdningen.
cast: Fredrik Wikingsson, Filip Hammar

name: SE - Dejta
cast: Maria Sundbom Lörelius, Klara Zimmergren, Bahareh Razekh, Christopher Wollter, Peshang Rad, Nova Waldfogel, Emelie Jonsson

name: SE - Sommaren 85
plot: Det är 1980-tal och i det lilla samhället Braxinge förbereder sig invånarna för att sjösätta en ny tradition – Den stora korvfesten som en gång för alla ska sätta byn på kartan.
cast: Elina Sätterman, Morgan Alling, Emma Broomé, Kajsa Ernst, Lotta Tejle, Elina Du Rietz

name: SE - Älska mig
plot: Hur hanterar olika generationer kärlek, sorg, passion och relationer? Möt läkaren Clara som dejtar utan att hitta rätt, störtförälskade lillebror Aron, och pappa Sten som finner oväntad passion.
cast: Josephine Bornebusch, Johan Ulveson, Gustav Lindh, Sverrir Gudnason, Görel Crona, Sofia Karemyr, Ia Langhammer, Dilan Gwyn

name: SE - Hamilton
plot: I kölvattnet av en serie bombningar och cyberattacker i Stockholm, befinner sig nu agenten Carl Hamilton sig snart på ett livshotande uppdrag. Mot en osynlig fiende, med spår som leder till ryska, Svenska och Amerikanska underrättelsestyrkor.
cast: Jakob Oftebro, Nina Zanjani, Jörgen Thorsson, Annika Hallin, Felice Jankell

name: SE - Maskineriet
cast: Kristoffer Joner, Julia Schacht, Hanna Alström, Emilia Roosmann, Anastasios Soulis, Maja Svärd
director: Richard Holm, Niclas Ekström, Kjersti Ugelstad

name: SE - Gaslight
plot: Ett psykologiskt drama om manipulation, våld och förförisk kärlek. När Noras planer för framtiden plötsligt sätts ur spel och inget går hennes väg så möter hon också den stora förälskelsen. Men den rosaskimrande relationen övergår snart i en destruktiv spiral där hela hennes överlevnad står på spel.
cast: Julia Heveus, Ivar Forsling, Suheib Saleh, Ella Sophie Sandberg, Joakim Olsson, Adam Jankovic, Adam Johansson, Nonni Ardal Hammarström

name: SE - Heder
cast: Anja Lundqvist, Julia Dufvenius, Alexandra Rapaport, Eva Röse, Jakob Eklund, Karin Bjurström, Ellen Bökman, Björn Kjellman
director: Anja Lundqvist, Sofia Helin, Julia Dufvenius

name: SE - Snabba Cash
plot: "Snabba Cash" är en reboot som utspelar sig i Stockholm, tio år efter händelserna i filmtrilogin. Leya är en ung ensamstående mamma som försöker lyckas inom startup-scenen. Miljön är livlig, jakten på status och pengar är starkare än någonsin och Leya är fast besluten att lyckas – oavsett pris. Den entreprenörsdrivna eliten och den kriminella världen har blivit allt mer brutal, kaotisk och skoningslös. När dessa två världar korsas sätts lojalitet, vänskap och affärsrelationer på prov.
cast: Evin Ahmad, Ali Alarik, Dada Fungula Bozela, Jozef Wojciechowicz, Alexander Abdallah, Ayaan Ahmed, Olle Sarri, Ghazal Khalili
director: Oskar Söderlund, Jesper Ganslandt, Jens Lapidus

name: SE - Advokaten
plot: Svensk thrillerserie om den begåvade försvarsadvokaten Frank Nordling på en av Sveriges främsta advokatbyråer. I barndomen bevittnade Frank sina föräldrars död och när han idag får veta att mördaren är en av ledarna inom Köpenhamns undre värld – och en av advokatbyråns viktigaste klienter – blir han besatt av hämnd.
cast: Alexander Karim, Malin Buska, Sara Hjort Ditlevsen, Susanne Storm, Thomas Bo Larsen, Nicolaj Kopernikus, Johannes Lassen, Liv Mjönes

name: SE - Det som göms i snö
plot: Rättssamhällets grundläggande principer ifrågasätts och dolda maktspel tar sig in i de fina korridorerna. Men gamla sanningar töar fram och i jakten på att dölja sina misstag drar sig inte lagens väktare för att bryta mot samhällets gemensamma regler.
cast: Robert Gustafsson, Louise Peterhoff, Johan Ulveson, Ingela Olsson, Christopher Wagelin, Ia Langhammer, Maria Sundbom

name: SE - Skärgårdsdoktorn
plot: TV-serie om läkaren Johan Steen som återvänder till Sverige efter att ha arbetat i Somalia. Han tar över sin svärfars verksamhet i skärgården och tillsammans med dottern Wilma försöker de skapa sig ett nytt liv.
cast: Samuel Fröler, Ebba Hultkvist Stragne, Sten Ljunggren, Helena Brodin, Göran Engman, Tove Nordin
director: Gunilla Linn Persson, Lars Bill Lundholm

name: SE - 30 grader i februari
plot: Några personer beger sig till Thailand i hopp om ett lyckligare liv. Den utarbetade tvåbarnsmodern Kajsa (Maria Lundqvist) drabbas av en stroke och bestämmer sig för att flytta till Thailand med sina döttrar, i förhoppning om att finna ro och livsglädje. Hon lämnar bostad och jobb bakom sig i Sverige och beger sig med familjen till bungalowhotellet Happiness där de vistats vid en tidigare semester. Happiness visar sig vara till salu så Kajsa bestämmer sig för att köpa det.nd.
cast: Kjell Wilhelmsen, Duangjai Hiransri, Lotta Tejle, Maria Lundqvist, Hanna Ardéhn, Viola Weidemann, Kjell Bergqvist, Thomas Chaanhing

name: SE - Trolltider (1979)
plot: Under trappan till människornas hus bor Vätten. Han har fin utsikt över gläntan i skogen där småtrollen bor. Det är systrarna Tova och Kleva som så småningom byter namn och kallar sig Daisy och Gloria. Det är gubben Gorm som är vaktmästare i stubben och hans son Kotte. De tillhör alla ett småfolk som inte mäter mer än 12 cm i strumplästen. Högt uppe i skogen bor också fen Dorabella och häxan Mara. Julkalendern Trolltider var så populär när den sändes att den även sändes som julkalendern 1985.

name: SE - Andra Avenyn
cast: Jonas Bane, Fortesa Hoti, Gunilla Johansson, Malena Laszlo, Fyr Thorvald Strömberg, Hans Mosesson, Lena B. Nilsson

name: SE - Top Dog
plot: Ett mystiskt försvinnande förenar två olika världar, och ett ytterst omaka par - juristen Emily och den villkorligt frigivna Teddy. De har två motsatta viljor. Hon vill upp. Han vill ut. Hon vill trygga sin framtid, han vill lämna sitt gamla liv. Båda tvingas tänka om när de hamnar mitt i en smutsig härva där det förflutna kommer ikapp, där framtidsdrömmar krossas, och där ingenting är vad det ser ut att vara.
cast: Josefin Asplund, Alexej Manvelov, Gustav Lindh, Jessica Grabowsky
director: Molly Hartleb, Alexis Almström, Veronica Zacco

name: SE- Lust
plot: Anette, Nadia, Ellen och Martina har alla varit vänner sedan barnsben. Då Anette, numera utredare på Hälsomyndigheten, tar sig an en undersökning under den något tveksamma parollen ”Sex är en motorväg till hälsa” blir de nyfikna. De frågar sig: påverkar bra sex – eller snarare bristen på det – hälsan för svenska kvinnor över 40? När ersattes passion med schemalagt torsdagssex?
cast: Sofia Helin, Anja Lundqvist, Julia Dufvenius, Elin Klinga, Amy Deasismont, Jacob Ericksson, Björn Bengtsson, Anton Forsdik

name: SE - I Huvudet på en Gärningsman
plot: Vi djupdyker in i psyket på några av Sveriges värsta brottslingar. Hur var deras barndom, vilka tecken fanns, och vad var det som slutligen drev dem till sexuella övergrepp och våld?

name: SE - Riding in Darkness
plot: Nattryttarna är en överlevnadshistoria och bygger på vittnesmål från de händelser som inträffade på ett ridcenter där unga flickor utnyttjades av en känd hästprofil som också hade sin familj boende på gården.
cast: Jonas Karlsson, Hanna Ardéhn, Melinda Kinnaman, Amanda Jansson, Emma Comstedt, Jessica Liedberg

name: SE - Hem till midgård
plot: Serien kretsar kring den fiktiva lilla byn Midgård, Nordens sista okristna by, belagd utanför Birka. Midgård är en liten by men ett ökänt rövarnäste bland lokalbefolkningen. Byns riktiga hövding, Snorre den Store, är ute på plundringsstråt med byns främsta män, och ansvaret för Midgård ligger istället på hans aningen inkompetente son Lill-Snorre. Med sig har han sina vänner, en brokig skara av inte så smarta individer, och de försöker ta hand om byn efter bästa förmåga, vilket inte går så bra.
cast: Fredde Granberg, Marko Lehtosalo, Sara Sommerfeld, Johan Petersson, Stefan Roos, Rolf Skoglund, Per Morberg, Gert Fylking
director: Johan Petersson, Stefan Roos, Fredde Granberg

name: SE - Den osannolika mördaren
plot: En dramatisering av hur Stig Engström, mannen som påstod sig ha bevittnat det ödesdigra dådet, i själva verket kan ha kommit undan med mordet på Olof Palme.
cast: Robert Gustafsson, Mikael Persbrandt, Cia Eriksson, Eva Melander, Björn Bengtsson, Cilla Thorell, Peter Viitanen, Joel Spira
director: Wilhelm Behrman, Niklas Rockström, Thomas Pettersson

name: SE - Trolltider – legenden om Bergatrollet
plot: Trolltider – the legend of the Bergatrollet is SVT's Christmas calendar 2023, directed by Lisa Farzaneh from a script by Ola Norén and Roland Ulvselius. The series is a "reboot" to SVT's Christmas calendar Trolltider from 1979 with partly the same characters but a new story.
cast: Matilda Gross, Ossian Skarsgård, Samuel Astor, Kjell Bergqvist, Lena-Pia Bernhardsson, Emma Broomé, Mimmi Cyon, Magnus Ehrner

name: SE - Dubbelliv
cast: Joel Bäcklund Reboia, Disa Dyall, Nils Forsen, Rosalia Haratourian, Julia Tedert Rambe, Sofia Wedin, Hanna Ardéhn, Joel Lützow

name: SE - Young Royals
cast: Edvin Ryding, Omar Rudberg, Malte Gårdinger, Frida Argento, Nikita Uggla
director: Lars Beckung, Lisa Ambjörn, Camilla Holter

name: SE - Mauri - Vad hände sen?
plot: En brokig skara med drömmöten där den gemensamma frågan Mauri ställer sig är "Vad hände sen?"
cast: Mauri Hermundsson

name: SE - Enkelstöten
plot: Läraren Jenny (Lotta Tejle) och läkaren Cecilia (Sissela Kyle) är två kvinnor i 60-årsåldern som lever vanliga medelklassliv i Kalmar. När de inser att framtiden är allt annat än ljus för dem bestämmer de sig för att göra något drastiskt, att råna ett bankkontor i Stockholm.
cast: Lotta Tejle, Sissela Kyle, Tomas von Brömssen, Ralph Carlsson, Fredrik Wagner

name: SE - Knutby

Berättelsen skildrar perioden som ledde fram till ett mord och ett mordförsök inom ortens lilla frikyrkoförsamling. Serien bygger på Jonas Bonniers roman med samma namn och är regisserad av Goran Kapetanović, senast aktuell med succéserien Kalifat.
cast: Alba August, Aliette Opheim, Amy Deasismont, Einar Bredefeldt, Emilia Roosmann, Jessica Liedberg, Joakim Sällquist, Nils Wetterholm

name: SE - Terese i kassan
plot: Hampus Nessvold är tillbaka i en helt egen serie i rollen som Sveriges mest älskade kassörska Terese i kassa 1. I butiken jobbar, förutom Terese också den mycket veliga butikschefen Pontus, den fyrkantiga arbetsledaren Lola och den arbetsskygga Anki.
cast: Hampus Nessvold, Emma Peters, Eric Stern, Anneli Martini, Rojan Telo, Julia Heveus

name: SE - Zebrarummet
plot: En ung elev från den anrika internatskolan Tuna Kvarn hittas död, ett mysterium som omgärdas av kompakt tystnad från skolans priviligierade ungdomar. En bit ifrån Tuna Kvarn ligger den kommunala Holmeredskolan, som snabbt blir utpekad som källan till tragedin. Nu riktas omvärldens blickar mot skolorna, och när en mobilfilm från Tuna Kvarns förnedrande initieringsriter läcker ut i sociala medier sätts oanade mekanismer i rörelse.
cast: Anton Forsdik, Tiam Miladi, Maxwell Vaz, Filip Slotte, Edvin Endre, Adja Krook, Valter Skarsgård, Alva Bratt

name: SE - Bron/Broen
plot: Bron, dansk titel Broen, är en svensk-dansk kriminalserie från 2011, som började sändas i Sveriges Television den 21 september 2011. Hans Rosenfeldt har skrivit manus efter en idé i samarbete med Måns Mårlind och Björn Stein. Sofia Helin och Kim Bodnia spelade huvudrollerna i de två första säsongerna, i den tredje och fjärde är Sofia Helin fortsatt huvudroll. Serien har fyra säsonger varav den sista sänds i början av 2018.
cast: Sofia Helin, Thure Lindhardt, Mikael Birkkjær, Sarah Boberg, Rafael Pettersson, Julie Carlsen

name: SE - Bonusfamiljen
plot: En svensk dramakomedi där ett nyblivet par, deras ex och alla barn försöker lösa bonusfamiljens känsloladdade och komplicerade livspussel.
cast: Erik Johansson, Vera Vitali, Emma Peters, Fredrik Hallgren, Nour El Refai, Matheo Bittar Johansson, Frank Dorsin, Jacob Lundqvist
director: Felix Herngren, Moa Herngren, Clara Herngren

name: SE - Lyckoviken
plot: Polisen Johanna återvänder till hemorten Hammarvik för sin mors begravning, samtidigt som liket efter en försvunnen flicka hittas i den lilla idyllen där alla verkar bära på hemligheter…
cast: Disa Östrand, Linda Santiago, Martin Stenmarck, Christopher Wollter

name: SE- BIANCA
plot: Filterlöst och oväntat när Bianca Ingrosso bjuder in svenska och internationella stjärnor till Sveriges nya stora talkshow – BIANCA.
cast: Bianca Ingrosso

name: SE - Tore
cast: William Spetz, Peter Haber, Sanna Sundqvist, Hannes Fohlin, Karin Bertling, Lotta Tejle, Per Svensson

name: SE - Den Svenska Tinderbedragaren
plot: Den svenska Tinderbedragaren är en dokumentärserie om ett antal kvinnor som har en sak gemensamt, de vittnar alla om att de har blivit bedragna av en och samma man. Efter att han byggt upp ett förtroende under en tid med kvinnorna genom sin charm och attraktiva livsstil kommer han med oemotståndliga erbjudande om anställningar, investeringar, partnerskap och andra effektiva klipp.

name: Summer with the Family
plot: Jens and wife Åsa pack up the family to spend the summer in the archipelago. The idyll, however, does not appear when it comes out that the in-laws do not intend to leave the cottage to Jens and Åsa, but plan to spend the whole summer there with them.
cast: Peter Magnusson, Christine Meltzer, Christopher Wagelin, Rakel Wärmländer, Krister Henriksson, Anki Lidén, Sam Herrgård, Elina Du Rietz
director: Staffan Lindberg, Peter Magnusson, Mikael Syrén

name: SE- Knekt
plot: Tre barndomskompisar från Sarpsborg startar ett hemligt kasino. Drömmen om rikedom har blivit sann, men ju mer svarta pengar - desto större problem.
cast: Johannes Roaldsen Fürst, Mikkel Bratt Silset, Deniz Kaya, Nokokure Dahl, Ine Jansen, Henrik Mestad
director: Jørgen Evensen, Johannes Roaldsen Fürst, Eirik Hvattum Bjørnstad

name: SE- Allt för Sverige
plot: Tio svensk-amerikaner kommer till Sverige för att få uppleva det land där de har sina rötter. Tårar, kulturkrockar och mycket skratt blandas med tävlingar som har anknytning till svenska seder och myter.
cast: Anders Lundin

name: SE - The Island Sverige
cast: Dermot Clemenger, Emma Igelström, Magdalena Kowalczyk, Lasse Kronér, Dragomir Mrsic, Linda Pira, Marcus Schenkenberg

name: SE - Styckmordet ingen vill lösa
plot: År 2007 döms Holger Algdal för mordet på sin fru. Kort efter att ha avtjänat sitt straff försvinner Holger spårlöst och hittas mördad i havet. Men vem är gärningsmannen? Och vad är motivet?

name: SE - Bingo & Julia
cast: Bingo Rimér, Julia Franzén

name: SE - Johanna Möller - Sveriges mest hatade kvinna
plot: Johanna Möller, blir känd som ”Arbogakvinnan” och döms till livstids fängelse för att vara hjärnan bakom det uppmärksammade "Sommarstugemordet", 2016. Men är Johanna Möller verkligen rätt dömd?
cast: Johanna Möller, Marko Tuhkanen, Sonny Björk, Jan Olsson, Bosse Åström

name: SE - Taelgia
plot: När Gabriel flyttar till ett miljonprogramsområde i Södertälje träffar han Marko, som är kung över springisarna. Marko tar sig an Gabriel och snart växer en vänskap fram innan Gabriel hinner förstå hur livsfarlig den är. När det begås ett spektakulärt misstag skapas ilska högre upp i den kriminella hierarkin. Taelgia berättar historien om familjer, polis och kriminella som befinner sig mitt i en korseld av lojaliteter, krav och skuld i ett och samma område.
cast: Sara Shirpey, Jonay Pineda Skallak, Kalled Mustonen, Oldoz Javidi, Nurbo bozan, Emma Broomé, Simon Mezher, Laura Majid

name: SE - Jag Är Huligan
plot: Vi följer människorna som slåss i sitt lags namn. Vilka är de? Och varför slåss de? Unikt material inifrån en Svensk huliganfirma.

name: SE - Ägd av Danny
plot: I det här programmet kommer Danny Saucedo pranka några av Sveriges mest älskade kändisar. Men han kommer också ge sig ut för att busa med ett gäng ovetande människor på stan.
cast: Danny Saucedo

name: SE - En helt vanlig familj
plot: En till synes perfekt familj ser sin värld falla samman när ett chockerande mord visar hur långt de är villiga att gå för att skydda varandra.
cast: Alexandra Karlsson Tyrefors, Lo Kauppi, Björn Bengtsson, Christian Fandango Sundgren, Melisa Ferhatovic, Håkan Bengtsson

name: SE - Hålla samman
plot: Systrarna Lina och Petra är varandras motsatser och bråken blir emellanåt stormiga, men de är experter på blixtsnabb konfliktlösning. När pappa Kenneth får en Alzheimer-diagnos ställs allas liv på ända. Något måste göras. Men Lina och Petra är förstås helt oense om vad.

name: SE - Welcome to Wrexham
plot: Rob McElhenney och Ryan Reynolds ska driva Wrexham Football Club samtidigt som de försöker skapa en underdog-historia om ett lag som resten av världen kan fängslas av och heja på. Dokumentärserien följer McElhenney och Reynolds och deras snabbkurs i klubbägarskap och det band som knyter samman laget och staden.
cast: Ryan Reynolds, Rob McElhenney

name: DK - Comedy kuren (2008) (DK)
plot:
Henrik Bruhn er Danmarks tykkeste komiker, men Anders Matthesen har givet ham en udfordring: Brug comedy til at tabe halvdelen af din kropsvægt. Og det er på høje tid, for Henriks krop er lige så stor, som hans selvværd er lille. Han har en fortid som professionel svindler og et repertoire bestående af platte vittigheder om sin fedme. Hvis kuren skal lykkes, må Henrik også blive et bedre menneske.

Comedy Kuren skildrer Henriks kamp mod kalorierne og mod alle de dårlige vaner, der har gjort ham overvægtig i første omgang. Den giver et unikt indblik i en arbejdende komikers hverdag, hvor selv de mest pinlige og intime oplevelser skal deles med publikum. Og den viser hans problemer med at lægge sine "fat jokes" og sine tvivlsomme forretninger på hylden - indtil han står på scenen i Falconer Salen som et forandret menneske 100 kilo tyndere og 100 % sjovere.

name: DK - Get a Life
plot:
Get a Life is a television sitcom that was broadcast in the United States on the Fox Network from September 23, 1990, to March 8, 1992. The show stars Chris Elliott as a 30-year-old paperboy named Chris Peterson. Peterson lived in an apartment above his parents' garage. The opening credits depict Chris Peterson delivering newspapers on his bike to the show's theme song, "Stand" by R.E.M.

The show was a creation of Elliott, Adam Resnick and writer/director David Mirkin. Mirkin was executive producer/showrunner of the series and also directed most of the episodes. Notable writers of the series included Charlie Kaufman, screenwriter of Being John Malkovich; and Bob Odenkirk, co-creator of Mr. Show with Bob and David and Tenacious D.

The show was unconventional for a prime time sitcom, and many times the storylines of the episodes were surreal. For example, Elliott's character actually dies in twelve episodes. The causes of death included being crushed by a giant boulder, old age, tonsillitis, stab wounds, gunshot wounds, falling from an airplane, strangulation, getting run over by cars, choking on cereal, and simply exploding. For this reason, it was a struggle for Elliott and Mirkin to get the show on the air. Many of the executives at the Fox Network hated the show and thought it was too disturbing and that Elliott's character was too insane.

name: DK - P.I.S. - Politiets indsatsstyrke
plot:
P.I.S. - Politiets indsatsstyrke is a Danish, satirical mockumentary from 2001. The show was originally broadcast on TV2 Zulu.

P.I.S. pretends to be a TV-documentary about Politiets IndsatsStyrke - a caricature of the real-world Politiets Aktionsstyrke, the Danish equivalent of a SWAT team. The film crew accompanies the unit, especially officer John Schmidt, both at work and in private. Initially the unit is pictured very convincingly as an actual police unit but as the show progress, the unit’s missions, attitudes and actions become more and more absurd, until it is obvious that it is a satirical mockumentary. When the first episodes were shown, many viewers thought it was an actual documentary.

The abbreviation P.I.S. means, in Danish, piss, which should be a dead give-away about the nature of the show. The style of the show, however, convinced many people that it was in fact a documentary, and that the abbreviation was just an unfortunate, but real, occurrence. Other Danish police and army institutions sound peculiar in Danish, when abbreviated, such as the Danish Defence Intelligence Service sounding like the Danish word for fairy, or the police equivalent, hence P.I.S. wasn't too far off.

name: DK - Matador
plot:
Matador is a Danish TV series produced and shown between 1978 and 1982. It is set in the fictional Danish town of Korsbæk between 1929 and 1947. It follows the lives of a range of characters from across the social spectrum, focusing specifically on the rivalry between the families of two businessmen: The banker Hans Christian Varnæs, an established local worthy, and social climber Mads Skjern, who arrives in town as the series opens. The name Matador was taken from the localised edition of the boardgame Monopoly, also the series' tentative English title. In addition, in contemporary Danish a "matador" is often used to describe a business tycoon, in the series referring to the character of Mads Skjern and his craftiness as a self-made entrepreneur.

Directed by famed Danish film maker Erik Balling, Matador was the idea of author Lise Nørgaard who wrote the bulk of the episodes alongside Karen Smith, Jens Louis Petersen and Paul Hammerich. The series is one of the most well-known and popular examples of Danish television and represents the peak of longtime development of Danish TV drama by the public service channel Danmarks Radio.

The series has become part of the modern self-understanding of Danes, partly because of its successful mix of melodrama and a distinct warm Danish humour in the depiction of characters, which were portrayed by a wide range of the most popular Danish actors at the time; but also not least because of its accurate portrayal of a turbulent Denmark from around the start of the Great Depression and through Nazi Germany's occupation of Denmark in World War II.

name: DK - Livvagterne
plot:
The Protectors is a British television series, an action thriller created by Gerry Anderson. It was Anderson's second TV series using live actors as opposed to electronic marionettes, and also his second to be firmly set in contemporary times. It was also the only Gerry Anderson produced television series that was not of the fantasy or science fiction genres. It was produced by Lew Grade's ITC Entertainment production company. Despite not featuring marionettes or any real science fiction elements, The Protectors became one of Anderson's most popular productions, easily winning a renewal for a second season. A third season was in the planning stages when the show's major sponsor pulled out, forcing its cancellation.

The Protectors first aired in 1972 and 1973, and ran to 52 episodes over two series, each 25 minutes long - making it one of the last series of this type to be produced in a half-hour format. It starred Robert Vaughn as Harry Rule, Nyree Dawn Porter as the Contessa Caroline di Contini, and Tony Anholt as Paul Buchet. Episodes often featured prominent guest actors.

Klovn is a Danish sitcom, which first aired on the Danish TV channel TV2 Zulu. It focuses on the life of the main character Frank and Casper. The show builds its comedy around quiet everyday situations, social awkwardness, uncomfortable silences and general faux pas.

Klovn usually gets compared to the American sitcom Curb Your Enthusiasm by Larry David. It’s also shot handheld, in a pseudo-realistic style. Some have also mistakenly compared the theme to Curb Your Enthusiasm’s, despite it being a direct reference to Jacques Tati’s Mr. Hulot movies. The poster for the first film can be seen in Casper and Frank’s offices throughout the series.  Klovn initially ran 6 seasons on TV2 Zulu from 2005-2009 and was renewed with an additional 3 seasons that aired from 2018-2022.
cast: Casper Christensen, Frank Hvam, Mia Lyhne, Michael Carøe, Dya Josefine Hauch, Kurt Dreyer, Lars Hjortshøj, Camilla Lehmann

Dette er første gang denne eksklusive gjengen er samlet og du kan oppleve de ekte individene som eksisterer bak den blendende fasaden. Diskusjonene blir intense, og det flommer over av champagne og følelser.Dette er en serie du ikke vil gå glipp av!
cast: Sophie Elise Isachsen, Isabel S. Raad, Anniken Englund Jørgensen, Nora Haukland

name: NO - Kompani Lauritzen: Tropp
plot: Tolv unge voksne som sliter med overgangen til voksenlivet har søkt seg inn i «Kompani Lauritzen: Tropp 1». Gjennom et militært regime preget av orden og disiplin må de unge rekruttene gjennom en rekke øvelser - der mestring, kameratskap og samhold står i fokus. Målet er at de skal lære å sette andre foran seg selv, erfare at man står sterkere sammen og få selvtilliten tilbake. Disse tolv kjemper ikke mot hverandre. De kjemper kun mot seg selv, sine egne begrensninger og sitt eget hode. Regelen er enkel: Gir de seg, er de ute.

name: NO - Toll
plot: Every day someone tries to smuggle drugs, money, weapons, alcohol and other illegal goods into Norway. In this documentary series, you get an exclusive insight into the job the customs officers do on several transitions along Norway's long border.

name: NO - Borettslaget (NO)
plot:
Tertitten borettslag på Carl Berner i Oslo er sentrum for Robert Stoltenbergs mange figurer. Her blir vi kjent med driftsleder Roy Narvestad og søsteren hans Ruth, den lett nevrotiske Linda Johansen, motekongen Yngve Freiholt, pakistanske Ali og den arbeidsløse finnen Piirka m.fl.

Borettslaget er Robert Stoltenbergs skråblikk på en god, gammel institusjon i det norske samfunnet, og rollefigurerne i serien er tatt helt på kornet. Han har selv hatt ideen til serien, og spiller også de fleste rollene. Stoltenberg har hatt flere serier på NRK tidligere,mange usker ham fra Copacabana og Café.
cast: Robert Stoltenberg, Sidsel Sørli

name: NO - Ylvis mot Ylvis: Kampen om gullplaten
cast: Bård Ylvisåker, Vegard Ylvisåker, Emilie Nicolas

name: NO - Kompani Lauritzen

De må vise at de kan holde hodet kaldt i stressende situasjoner, ha mot til å overvinne sine største frykter og fobier og vise viljestyrke når det virkelig røyner på. De fire som til slutt står igjen, må gjennomføre et spektakulært oppdrag der det til slutt vil kåres én vinner.
cast: Dag Otto Lauritzen, Kristian Ødegård, Nora Haukland, Vår Staude, Aleksander Sæterstøl, Hedvig Sophie Glestad, Mikkel Bratt Silset, Karin Klouman

Russland får derfor i oppdrag fra EU å gå inn i Norge og ta kontroll over oljeproduksjonen. Hvordan skal statsminister Berg forholde seg til en slik situasjon, og hvordan reagerer det norske folk på å være okkupert av en annen statsmakt?

name: NO - Gift ved første blikk

På bakgrunn av ulike personlighetstester og dybdeintervjuer overlates livets vanskeligste avgjørelse til ekspertene. Etter fem uker som ektefolk må de velge om de vil forbli gift eller signere skilsmissepapirene. Det er duket for den sjette sesongen av den populære realityserien, og seks helt fremmede skal bli til tre nye ektepar.

name: FI - Top Gear Suomi

name: FI - Pohjolan laki

Het is een allesbehalve makkelijke opgave om Puis XIII op te volgen. Hoewel John Paul III de perfecte paus lijkt te zijn, heeft hij geheimen en is hij kwetsbaar. name: BE-NL - Dcera národa (2024) (CZ)

Wanneer ze verliefd wordt op een Poolse officier van het Oostenrijkse leger verandert ze in de ogen van het publiek van een geliefd meisje in een verrader van de natie. Hij wordt echter naar het noordoosten van Schotland gestuurd om een ​​opleiding tot rechercheur te volgen. name: BE-NL - Acquitted (Frikjent) (2015) (NO)
plot:
De serie bestaat uit tien afleveringen van zo'n veertig minuten waarbij je gaandeweg meegezogen wordt in het verhaal. Al hoewel alles zich richt op het hier en nu, speelt onderliggend feitelijk alleen de vraag 'wie is verantwoordelijk voor de dood van het meisje, nu twintig jaar geleden?'. Dat maakt dat je gaandeweg de serie zelf probeert te achterhalen wie er verantwoordelijk is, maar telkens weer in onzekerheid wordt gebracht omdat niet alleen veel mensen destijds een motief hadden, maar ook in het hier en nu problemen hebben in de relationele en/of zakelijke sfeer.

De entourage van de overname van het familiebedrijf en de ontwikkelingen daarin spelen een rol, maar zijn achteraf enkel om het verhaal body te geven. Pas in de slotaflevering komen de belangrijkste zaken bij elkaar en krijg je als kijker duidelijkheid over hetgeen er zich daadwerkelijk destijds heeft afgespeeld. Overige zaken worden slechts ten dele uitgewerkt zodat je als kijker ook zelf mag meebepalen hoe een en ander zal aflopen. Dit maakt het een integer geheel waarbij geweld met name gevoeld maar niet gezien wordt.

Voor mensen die - net als ik - van Scandinavische series houden is dit een bijzonder fraai geslaagde serie. De serie zal geen vervolg krijgen en dat maakt ook dat je als kijker een keurig geheel voorgeschoteld krijgt zonder losse eindjes op plaatsen waar je die niet wil hebben (zoals de schuldvraag).
cast: Nicolai Cleve Broch, Tobias Santelmann, Synnøve Macody Lund, Lena Endre, Ingar Helge Gimle, Henrik Rafaelsen, Anne Marit Jacobsen, Ellen Dorrit Petersen
